inserted: The 1935 citizenship law and its first regulation make an ancestry classification consequential through voting and public office. The deciding institution converts its category into a distribution of rights, then presents that instituted distinction as natural being. The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-vii-germany) **historicises** this closure through those two instruments; Fichte’s earlier address remains a different witness, with the intervening conduits still requiring their own evidence.

inserted: The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-xii-computation) **tests** disclosure by whether a returned consequence can alter the criterion which produced it. DPO’s optimal and reference policies have distinct mathematical offices; the institutional account must also identify who selected the preference data, proxy and use. Ostrom’s selected principles supply a comparison for affected users changing rules and for nested governance. Their presence in an account establishes neither an implemented computational return nor a verdict on phenomenality.

inserted: The [language, law and nation history](../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md#branch-xi-postwar) **qualifies** the completed act through the costs and correction rights it carries forward. Paperclip’s stated screening rule and the Gehlen archival disclosure identify different institutional relations; neither certifies every appointment. The next commission must retain the authority which admitted a capacity, the consequences borne by others and their means of revising its use. A technical record performs that return only when the relevant governing condition can change.
